name: Cathy Gabrielsen
reason: Strict health rule: her own site presents her as a 'Trauma-Informed Holistic Healer' whose main work (holistic counselling, the Personal Healing Intensive, healing services) is sold on anxiety, PTSD, trauma, grief and illness, alongside a cancer non-profit and a mental-health counselling degree; her homepage is a 'coming soon' placeholder and her YouTube channel (113 subscribers) has a single two-minute devotional clip and no teaching videos. Her Kripalu programmes (Lucid Dreaming online on 2 Dec 2026, and Deborah King's LifeForce weekend 22-24 Jan 2027, where she is a supporting teacher) are current; checked 1 Nov 2026.
